experiment: FlyGraph R54 adaptive uncertainty-triggered ECC branching
frozen_reasoning_stack: R35 verifier, beam width 32, edge expand 8

main.policy: exact R52/R35 raw candidate support on every hypothesis-step; if ECC top1-top2 log-posterior margin <= calibrated threshold, add top-4 discrete ECC-induced candidate support; never average addresses or reasoning states

calibration.selection_rule: max F1 for detecting hard top-1 ECC decoder errors, subject to trigger_rate<=0.35; ties prefer lower trigger rate

ablation: always-on R53 top-4 discrete ECC branching, same frozen R52 codebook, R35 scorer, top_k=4 and beta=0.10
success_criterion: 8-hop delta vs R52 >= -2pp; adaptive branching strictly improves 64 and 128 answer over R52 and always-on R53 top-4, while reducing 128-hop candidate evaluations by >=30% vs always-on.
completion_note: id8/32/64 completed as full condition batches. The first shell wrapper for 128 ended after two fully written seed batches; seed 5453 was run separately. Only the six fully completed 128-hop episodes are aggregated.
